problems.quote: He looked the document up — wrong; correct He looked up the document

problems.quote: She not only sang but also danced (both non‑finite)

problems.quote: splits an inseparable phrasal verb (e.g., "look the information up" instead of "look up the information")
problems.problem: "Look up" is a separable phrasal verb, not inseparable; splitting it with a noun object ("look the information up") is grammatical. Inseparable phrasal verbs (e.g., "look after") cannot be split.

problems.quote: Determiners such as "each", "every", "any", "no" require singular count nouns
problems.problem: "Any" and "no" do not require singular count nouns; they combine with plural count nouns ("any students", "no errors") and uncountable nouns ("any water", "no time"). Only "each" and "every" strictly require singular count nouns.
problems.correction: Determiners such as "each" and "every" require singular count nouns, whereas "any" and "no" combine with singular, plural, or uncountable nouns
problems.verifierReason: Original incorrectly groups 'any'/'no' with 'each'/'every'; 'any'/'no' allow plural/uncountable nouns.
